supporting_pages.title: Datastore Admin \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: To restore backup data from a source application to a target application: Create an Identity and Access Management (IAM) policy on the source application's storage bucket with the following permission: Principal : [PROJECT ID]@appspot.gserviceaccount.com Roles : Storage Legacy Bucket Reader and Storage Legacy Object Reader where [PROJECT ID] is the project ID of the target application.
Database access permissions By default, Datastore Admin can access a Datastore database in the same project and does not require Identity and Access Management permissions for Datastore.
Warning: A user with access to Datastore Admin can use its features to modify Datastore data regardless of that user's Identity and Access Management permissions.
